limitsAndDirection: The sampled maximum is not an exact peak. The stream records a temporary exact-cgroup-unavailable period before sampling, and 250 ms polling can miss a higher transient. Shmem-heavy cgroup accounting does not by itself prove which path or test allocated memory; ordinal 6 identifies the active test when the run stopped, not sole causation.

Do not promote the five completed test files into a suite PASS, infer a certificate, or rerun this same attempt. Diagnose the bounded sandbox memory footprint or select a distinct reviewed policy-compliant repair, then create a new exact candidate and proof run.
